text.p: Lithuanian newspapers carried the following reports in their Wednesday editions. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- The Lithuanian parliament has postponed discussions on a draft bill initiated by President Algirdas Brazauskas to unilaterally define the sea border with Baltic neighbour Latvia.
- Lietuvos Energija (Lithuania Energy) has accumulated only 300,000 tonnes of heating oil for the winter season. Last year the Lithuanian heating system used 800,000 tonnes.

- Lithuanian parliament appointed four MPs to the National Radio and Television Board on Tuesday. Under the Mass Media Law four members of the board are appointed by parliament, three by the president and six by public organisations.
- The Confederation of Lithuanian Industrialists wants 30 percent of foreign loans with state guarantees to be distributed to the industrial sector.
